description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different transformer layer groups for five distinct KV cache compression configurations, as compared to a 4-bit baseline. The x-axis represents grouped transformer layers — “Layer1-4”, “Layer5-12”, “Layer13-20”, “Layer21-28”, and “Layer29-32” — with no numerical scale, serving as categorical labels. The y-axis, labeled “Relative Change”, is a linear percentage scale ranging from -25% to +5%, with major gridlines and tick labels at 5% intervals. Five lines are plotted: the yellow line with circle markers (“LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit”) starts near 0%, dips slightly to -2% at Layer5-12, drops to -4% at Layer13-20, then recovers to near 0% by Layer29-32. The red line with square markers (“LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit”) remains close to 0% across all layers, with minor fluctuations between -1% and +1%. The light blue line with circle markers (“RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit”) begins at -2%, drops to -4% at Layer5-12, plunges to -13% at Layer13-20, then rises to -2% at Layer29-32. The dark blue line with square markers (“RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit”) starts at -4%, falls to -6% at Layer5-12, drops sharply to -25% at Layer13-20, then climbs to -4% at Layer29-32. The gray dashed line (“Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit”) remains flat at 0% across all layers, serving as the reference point for relative change.
